title: [Ledger Inspector] List filters persist in the URL
preconditions: Signed in as an allowlisted internal admin with Ledger Inspector access.
description: Maps to Phase 2 AC: all list filters round-trip through the URL; refresh and deeplink restore the exact view. Source: GET-17183.

steps.action: Open Ledger Inspector and set Search, Provider, Status, Practice ID, and any failure-kind / Close Next filters; go to a later page.
steps.expected_result: The list updates to the filtered view and the URL contains those filters (search/practice update after the debounce, not on every keystroke).

steps.action: Refresh the page, then paste the same URL into a new tab.
steps.expected_result: Both restore the exact filtered view (same filters, same page).

steps.action: On a later page, change Provider, Status, or a checkbox/multi-select filter.
steps.expected_result: The list returns to page 1 rather than showing an empty later page; changing only the page number keeps your place.

steps.action: Click a client row, then use Back. Then click Clear filters.
steps.expected_result: The detail opens with the filters that produced the list still applied; Back returns to that filtered list. Clear filters empties every control and the URL.

steps.action: Paste an old bookmarked link such as /ledger-inspector?status=error.
steps.expected_result: The browser redirects to /internal/ledger-inspector with the status=error filter still applied and the list filtered to error rows.

steps.action: Edit the URL to include a malformed value, for example page=-1 or provider=foo, and load it.
steps.expected_result: Only that one filter is dropped (page falls back to 1, provider to all); every other filter in the URL stays applied and the page renders normally with no error screen.
